localization.name: Localization Upgrade (defs + file-kind prior + LLM rerank)
localization.effect: Measurable +23.4% absolute gain in hit@8 (+54% relative), lifting search ceiling for downstream coders.

symbol_targeting.name: Symbol Scope Targeting (structural operator table + reachability)
symbol_targeting.metric: Gold symbol in top-3 candidates (N=6 apply samples)
symbol_targeting.effect: Directional improvement; reduces context window bloat and centers patch generation on defective callable.

static_gates.name: Static AST & Compile Gating (ast.parse, py_compile, pyflakes)
static_gates.effect: Eliminates all unparseable or malformed diffs before container execution; 100% of submitted patches parse cleanly.

closed_loop.name: Closed-Loop Traceback Retry (max 2 repair rounds with trimmed traceback)
closed_loop.metric: Apply recovery rate on context mismatches (N=8 baseline apply failures)
closed_loop.effect: Verbatim surrounding context on apply failure converts 50% of context mismatches into clean patches.

tournament_diversity.name: Tournament Size & Model Diversity
tournament_diversity.effect: Multi-model diversity (config c) outperforms single-model multi-temperature (config b) by +13.4% patch generation rate.

repro_verification.name: Repro-Test Selection Gate (red before patch, green after patch)

baseline.description: Accept any candidate passing static gates

upgraded.description: Require repro test confirmation or neutral fallback

repro_verification.effect: Red/green verification discards fixes that do not change bug behavior, filtering out deceptive non-fixes.

laya_calibration.name: LAYA Calibration & Logistic Combiner
laya_calibration.metric: ECE & Brier score on held-out validation split (N=103 validation labels)
laya_calibration.effect: Temperature scaling drops calibration error from 0.0924 to 0.0010 (98.9% reduction); logistic weights properly balance hard test signals over subjective scores.
